detail: SP-050 names a ListSessionPins RPC. ListSessions (SP-016) already lists every session pin with its harness, PID, space, first directory, liveness and command-log counts, scoped per caller, so SP-050 adds no second RPC and the Spaces pane (SP-054) reads pins from ListSessions. If the pane needs a field ListSessions lacks (e.g. the chain owner of RC-81), add it to SessionInfo instead.
